title: Hush Little Baby
source: YouTube official English captions checked locally; Chinese translation added for HelloLILI

cues.en: (bright music)
cues.zh: 明亮的音乐

cues.en: (gentle music)
cues.zh: 轻柔的音乐

cues.en: ♪ Hush, little baby, don't say a word ♪
cues.zh: 嘘，小宝贝，别出声

cues.en: ♪ Mama's gonna buy you a mockingbird ♪
cues.zh: 妈妈会给你买一只知更鸟

cues.en: (bright music)
cues.zh: 明亮的音乐

cues.en: ♪ And if that mockingbird don't sing ♪
cues.zh: 如果那只知更鸟不唱歌

cues.en: ♪ Mama's gonna buy you a diamond ring ♪
cues.zh: 妈妈会给你买一枚钻石戒指

cues.en: ♪ And if that diamond ring turns to brass ♪
cues.zh: 如果那枚钻石戒指变成黄铜

cues.en: ♪ Mama's gonna buy you a looking glass ♪
cues.zh: 妈妈会给你买一面镜子

cues.en: ♪ And if that looking glass gets broke ♪
cues.zh: 如果那面镜子碎了

cues.en: ♪ Mama's gonna buy you a billy goat ♪
cues.zh: 妈妈会给你买一只小山羊

cues.en: (bright music)
cues.zh: 明亮的音乐

cues.en: ♪ And if that billy goat gets cross ♪
cues.zh: 如果那只小山羊发脾气

cues.en: ♪ Mama's gonna buy you a rocking horse ♪
cues.zh: 妈妈会给你买一匹摇摇马

cues.en: ♪ And if that rocking horse turns over ♪
cues.zh: 如果那匹摇摇马翻倒了

cues.en: ♪ Mama's gonna buy you a dog named Rover ♪
cues.zh: 妈妈会给你买一只叫 Rover 的小狗

cues.en: ♪ And if that dog named Rover won't bark ♪
cues.zh: 如果那只叫 Rover 的小狗不叫

cues.en: ♪ Mama's gonna buy you a horse and cart ♪
cues.zh: 妈妈会给你买一匹马和一辆车

cues.en: ♪ And if that horse and cart fall down ♪
cues.zh: 如果那匹马和那辆车倒下了

cues.en: ♪ You'll still be the sweetest little baby in town ♪
cues.zh: 你仍然是镇上最甜的小宝贝

cues.en: (gentle music)
cues.zh: 轻柔的音乐
